answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 27122 Country: India Title: I belongs to a poor family and my parents not in condition of submitting my college fee. i want to complete my graduation in this condition can i take loan from any bank?and my second question is is scholarship is jayaj in islam which is provided to poor students? Question: i belongs to a poor family and my parents not in condition of submitting my college fee. i want to complete my graduation in this condition can i take loan from any bank?and my second question is is scholarship is jayaj in islam which is provided to poor students? Answer ID: 27122 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1973/1581/B=1431) (1) In case, you take loan from the bank you will have to pay interest, which is unlawful and haram. (2) It is right for a poor to receive the scholarship that is meant for the poor. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
